sql.if: WITH RECURSIVE medata_set_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT dt1.medata_set_id, dt1.medata_set_id AS root_id, 1 AS depth FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dt1 WHERE dt1.geodata_val IS NOT NULL AND dtmeta.ST_Contains( dtmeta.ST_SetSRID(dtmeta.ST_GeomFromText(#{polygon}), 4326), dtmeta.ST_SetSRID(dt1.geodata_val, 4326) ) UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT dt1.medata_set_id, ids.root_id, ids.depth + 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dt1 JOIN medata_set_ids ids ON dt1.medata_val = ids.medata_set_id WHERE ids.depth < 5 )

mapper.select: SELECT ds.medata_set_id AS id , ds.medata_set_nm AS name , m.type_model_id AS type_id , COALESCE(tm.model_logic_nm, tm.model_nm, m.type_model_id) AS type FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model m ON m.model_id = ds.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model tm ON tm.model_id = m.type_model_id WHERE ds.medata_set_id IN #{i}

SELECT DISTINCT pp.prpty_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property pp JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine pd ON pd.prpty_id = pp.prpty_id AND pd.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rm ON rm.model_id = pd.range_model_id AND rm.model_type_mtcd = 'object_type' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty mp ON mp.prpty_id = pp.prpty_id AND mp.model_prpty_del_yn = 'N' WHERE pp.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use'
mapper.sql:
WHERE 1=1
AND ds.medata_set_sttus_mtcd != 'disuse'
AND ( ds.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR ds.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR COALESCE(ds.medata_set_desc, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%')
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dd_q JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property pp_q ON pp_q.prpty_id = dd_q.prpty_id AND pp_q.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine pd_q ON pd_q.prpty_id = pp_q.prpty_id AND pd_q.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rm_q ON rm_q.model_id = pd_q.range_model_id AND rm_q.data_type_mtcd IN ('keywordsKo', 'keywordsEn') JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty mp_q ON mp_q.prpty_id = pp_q.prpty_id AND mp_q.model_prpty_del_yn = 'N' WHERE dd_q.medata_set_id = ds.medata_set_id AND dd_q.medata_val ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ) )
AND m.type_model_id = #{typeModelId}
AND ds.medata_set_id IN (SELECT medata_set_id FROM dt_scope)
AND ds.medata_set_id IN (SELECT medata_set_id FROM medata_set_ids)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model m ON m.model_id = ds.model_id

WITH object_prpty_ids AS ( SELECT DISTINCT pp.prpty_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_property pp JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_propertydefine pd ON pd.prpty_id = pp.prpty_id AND pd.prpty_def_chg_yn = 'N' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model rm ON rm.model_id = pd.range_model_id AND rm.model_type_mtcd = 'object_type' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_modelproperty mp ON mp.prpty_id = pp.prpty_id AND mp.model_prpty_del_yn = 'N' WHERE pp.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' ) SELECT dd.medata_val AS descendant_id , parent_ds.medata_set_id AS ancestor_id , parent_ds.medata_set_nm AS ancestor_nm , parent_m.type_model_id AS ancestor_type_id FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dd JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset parent_ds ON parent_ds.medata_set_id = dd.medata_set_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model parent_m ON parent_m.model_id = parent_ds.model_id WHERE dd.prpty_id IN (SELECT prpty_id FROM object_prpty_ids) AND dd.medata_val IN #{id}

SELECT ds.medata_set_id AS id , ds.medata_set_nm AS name , COALESCE(tm.model_logic_nm, tm.model_nm, m.model_nm) AS type , m.type_model_id AS type_id , ds.medata_set_desc AS description , ds.medata_set_amd_dt AS updated_at , '' AS breadcrumb
, ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY[
CASE WHEN ds.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') OR ds.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') THEN 'name' END , CASE WHEN COALESCE(ds.medata_set_desc, '') ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') THEN 'desc' END , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dd_k JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property pp_k ON pp_k.prpty_id = dd_k.prpty_id AND pp_k.prpty_nm = 'keywords' AND pp_k.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' WHERE dd_k.medata_set_id = ds.medata_set_id AND dd_k.medata_val ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ) THEN 'keywords' END , CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dd_s JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property pp_s ON pp_s.prpty_id = dd_s.prpty_id AND pp_s.prpty_nm = 'subjects' AND pp_s.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' WHERE dd_s.medata_set_id = ds.medata_set_id AND dd_s.medata_val ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{q}, '%') ) THEN 'subjects' END ,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dd_g WHERE dd_g.medata_set_id = ds.medata_set_id AND dd_g.geodata_val IS NOT NULL AND dtmeta.ST_Contains( dtmeta.ST_SetSRID(dtmeta.ST_GeomFromText(#{polygon}), 4326), dtmeta.ST_SetSRID(dd_g.geodata_val, 4326) ) ) THEN 'polygon' END ,
NULL ], NULL), ',') AS matched_fields FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model m ON m.model_id = ds.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model tm ON tm.model_id = m.type_model_id
ORDER BY ds.medata_set_amd_dt DESC NULLS LAST, ds.medata_set_id LIMIT #{pageListSize} OFFSET (#{curPage} - 1) * #{pageListSize}

( SELECT 'name' AS kind , ds.medata_set_nm AS value , COUNT(*) AS cnt , MAX(ds.medata_set_amd_dt) AS latest FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds WHERE ds.medata_set_sttus_mtcd != 'disuse' AND ( ds.medata_set_nm ILIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') OR ds.medata_set_logic_nm ILIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') ) GROUP BY ds.medata_set_nm ORDER BY CASE WHEN ds.medata_set_nm = #{q} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , MAX(ds.medata_set_amd_dt) DESC NULLS LAST , length(ds.medata_set_nm) , ds.medata_set_nm LIMIT 10 ) UNION ALL ( SELECT 'keyword' AS kind , dd.medata_val AS value , COUNT(*) AS cnt , MAX(ds.medata_set_amd_dt) AS latest FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_data dd JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_property pp ON pp.prpty_id = dd.prpty_id AND pp.prpty_nm IN ('keywords', 'subjects') AND pp.prpty_data_sttus_mtcd = 'use' JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds ON ds.medata_set_id = dd.medata_set_id WHERE dd.medata_val IS NOT NULL AND dd.medata_val ILIKE CONCAT(#{q}, '%') GROUP BY dd.medata_val ORDER BY CASE WHEN dd.medata_val = #{q} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END , MAX(ds.medata_set_amd_dt) DESC NULLS LAST , length(dd.medata_val) , dd.medata_val LIMIT 10 )

AND ds.medata_set_id IN (SELECT medata_set_id FROM dt_scope)

SELECT m.type_model_id AS type_id , COALESCE(tm.model_logic_nm, tm.model_nm, m.type_model_id) AS type_name , COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model m ON m.model_id = ds.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model tm ON tm.model_id = m.type_model_id
GROUP BY m.type_model_id , COALESCE(tm.model_logic_nm, tm.model_nm, m.type_model_id) , tm.model_sort_odrg ORDER BY tm.model_sort_odrg NULLS LAST, type_name

SELECT m.type_model_id AS type_id , COALESCE(tm.model_logic_nm, tm.model_nm, m.type_model_id) AS type_name , COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dtmeta.tb_meta_dataset ds LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model m ON m.model_id = ds.model_id LEFT OUTER JOIN dtmeta.tb_meta_model tm ON tm.model_id = m.type_model_id WHERE 1=1
AND ds.medata_set_sttus_mtcd != 'disuse'
GROUP BY m.type_model_id , COALESCE(tm.model_logic_nm, tm.model_nm, m.type_model_id) , tm.model_sort_odrg ORDER BY tm.model_sort_odrg NULLS LAST, type_name
